name: Driving without a valid driving licence
act: Motor Traffic Act (Amended by Act No. 10 of 2019)
description: Operating any class of motor vehicle without holding a valid driving licence for that class. Subsequent conviction carries Rs. 30,000 - Rs. 50,000.

name: Permitting unlicensed person to drive
act: Motor Traffic Act (Amended by Act No. 10 of 2019)
description: Owner or employer employing or permitting any person who does not hold a valid driving licence to drive on a road.

name: Underage driving (under 18 light / under 21 heavy)
act: Motor Traffic Act (Amended by Act No. 10 of 2019)
description: Driving light vehicle before age 18 or heavy vehicle before age 21. Subsequent conviction carries Rs. 40,000 - Rs. 50,000.

name: Failure to carry or produce driving licence on demand
description: Failing to carry driving licence or produce it when demanded by a police officer. If court prosecution ensues, fine is Rs. 2,500 - Rs. 5,000.

name: Driving with expired or invalid driving licence
description: Driving after expiry of licence validity without renewal.

name: Learner driver unaccompanied by licensed instructor
description: Learner driving on road without being accompanied by a licensed instructor occupying the front seat, or without standard L plates.

name: Driving without valid third-party insurance
act: Motor Traffic Act (Amended by Act No. 10 of 2019)
description: Using a motor vehicle on a road without a valid certificate of insurance covering third-party risks. Also carries up to 1 month imprisonment.

name: Failure to produce certificate of insurance
description: Failure to produce certificate of insurance upon demand or within 5 days at designated police station.

name: Driving without valid revenue licence
description: Operating a motor vehicle without an annual revenue licence in force or failing to affix licence to windscreen.

name: Unregistered motor vehicle on highway
description: Possession or use of an unregistered motor vehicle on any road without registration plate or temporary permit.

name: Failure to report change of vehicle ownership (MTA 6)
description: Failure by seller or buyer to deliver transfer notices (M.T.A. 6) within 14 days of change of possession.

name: Speeding: Up to 20% in excess of speed limit
description: Driving in excess of prescribed speed limit by up to 20% (e.g. 60-72 km/h in a 60 km/h zone).

name: Speeding: 20% to 30% in excess of speed limit
description: Driving in excess of prescribed speed limit by 20% to 30% (e.g. 72-78 km/h in a 60 km/h zone).

name: Speeding: 30% to 50% in excess of speed limit
description: Driving in excess of prescribed speed limit by 30% to 50% (e.g. 78-90 km/h in a 60 km/h zone).

name: Speeding: Greater than 50% in excess of speed limit
description: Extreme speeding exceeding speed limit by more than 50% (e.g. >90 km/h in a 60 km/h zone). Court prosecution mandatory.

name: Excessive vehicle exhaust noise (silencer modification)
description: Motor vehicle silencer altered or defective emitting noise exceeding statutory limits (85 dB(A) for motorcycles).

name: Multi-tone, musical, or harsh sound horn (air horn)
description: Fitting or sounding a horn that emits harsh, shrill, multi-tone or musical sound.

name: Failure to wear certified protective helmet (SLS 517)
description: Riding or pillion riding on a motorcycle without a protective helmet complying with SLS 517 standard or without chin strap securely fastened.

name: Excessive vehicular smoke emission (dark smoke / black smoke)
description: Operating a vehicle emitting visible smoke, visible vapor or exhaust pollutants in excess of prescribed opacity limits.

name: Defective headlamps, tail lamps or stop lights
description: Driving at night or dusk without required illuminating headlamps, clearance lamps, or red tail warning lamps.

name: Using mobile phone while driving (wireless device)
act: Motor Traffic Act (Amended by Act No. 10 of 2019)
description: Using a cellular mobile phone or handheld communication device while driving a motor vehicle without a hands-free device.

name: Disobeying traffic light signals or traffic police signs
description: Passing a red light signal, disregarding illuminated traffic directions, or disobeying hand signals of a police officer directing traffic.

name: Failure to observe lane discipline (crossing continuous white line)
description: Crossing solid single or double white centre lines, improper overtaking, or reckless lane hopping.

name: Failure to stop vehicle after road accident (Hit and Run)
description: Driver involved in an accident causing injury or damage failing to immediately stop, assist injured persons, or report to the nearest police station.

name: Driving without fastening front seat belts
description: Driver or front seat passenger failing to wear a properly adjusted and securely fastened safety seat belt.

name: Reckless, dangerous, or careless driving
act: Motor Traffic Act (Amended by Act No. 10 of 2019)
description: Driving dangerously, negligently, or without due care and attention. Second conviction carries Rs. 15,000 - Rs. 30,000 and licence suspension.
